mcp_tools.description:
List backend classes (QPUs/simulators) available to the user.

Args:
    online_only: Prefer backends accepting jobs / not offline.
    device_type: Filter by type string (e.g. QPU, simulator) if provided.
    name_contains: Case-insensitive substring match on name/short_code.
    max_qubits: Best-effort filter when qubit count is known.
    limit: Max backends to return.
mcp_tools.name: list_backends

mcp_tools.description: List job categories and subcategories (for job_subcategory_id).
mcp_tools.name: list_job_categories

mcp_tools.description:
List recent jobs for an organization.

Uses organization_id, else OPENQUANTUM_ORGANIZATION_ID, else the first org.
mcp_tools.name: list_jobs

mcp_tools.description: List organizations for the authenticated Open Quantum account.
mcp_tools.name: list_organizations

mcp_tools.description:
Upload circuit, prepare job, return quote. Does not create/spend yet.

Provide exactly one of qasm (OpenQASM source string) or file_path.
file_path is read by this process and uploaded — do not pass sensitive paths.

Args:
    execution_plan: auto (prefer Public for Spark), public, private, or plan UUID.
    queue_priority: auto, standard, priority, instant, or priority UUID.

Default job_subcategory_id is oth:oth. Response includes quote_summary pricing.
mcp_tools.name: prepare_job

mcp_tools.description:
Create a job (deducts credits). Does NOT wait for completion.

Either pass preparation_id from prepare_job, or one-shot fields
(backend_class_id + qasm/file_path). file_path is uploaded as-is.

Args:
    execution_plan: auto (prefer Public), public, private, or plan UUID.
    queue_priority: auto, standard, priority, instant, or priority UUID.
    confirm_spend: Required true when spend would use Full credits.

Spend policy: max credits cap (default 10). Spark-covered Public jobs
auto-approve. Full credit spend requires confirm_spend=true.
mcp_tools.name: submit_job

mcp_tools.description:
Poll until job is terminal or timeout. On timeout returns current status.

Defaults come from OPENQUANTUM_MCP_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (600) and
OPENQUANTUM_MCP_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS (5.0) when args are omitted.

Long QPU queues are expected — re-call this tool or use get_job later.
mcp_tools.name: wait_for_job
